content.text: Governing law and venue fully match the preferred position, and there is no arbitration clause anywhere in the document.

input.quote: the validity, interpretation and legal effect of this Agreement shall be governed by the internal laws of the State of New York, U.S.A., applicable to contracts entered in and performed entirely within the State of New York, U.S.A. without regard to any conflict of law principles.
input.rationale: Article XXIV(a) selects the internal laws of the State of New York, and the following paragraph requires any suit to be instituted in the City of New York, State of New York, with irrevocable submission to the exclusive jurisdiction of the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York or any New York state court, plus waivers of venue objections and forum non conveniens. That is New York law with exclusive New York state and federal court venue, matching the preferred position. A document-wide search returns no arbitration provision, so there is no foreign arbitration seat or offshore forum to flag. No redline needed.
